Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 75: October 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #75 shipped to subscribers in September 2007 (bearing the cover date of October 2007 for Issue 75). Built as a native Xbox 360-exclusive disc, Disc #75 was packed with high-definition playable demos and Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials during one of the biggest fall launch seasons in Xbox history:

FIFA 08 (soccer simulation)
NHL 08 (ice hockey simulation)
NBA Live 08 (basketball simulation)
Juiced 2: Hot Import Nights (street racing and drift simulation)
Conan (hack-and-slash action-adventure)
Streets of Rage 2 (Xbox Live Arcade classic side-scrolling beat 'em up)
Cyberball 2072 (Xbox Live Arcade futuristic sci-fi sports)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included custom downloadable dashboard themes, gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring major launch-window coverage for Halo 3, Project Gotham Racing 4, Mass Effect, and The Orange Box, along with OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
